question: What is the meaning of social life cycle assessment (slca) in relation to chemical?
description: Social Life Cycle Assessment (SLCA) evaluates the social and sociological impacts of products throughout their life cycle, focusing on human well-being. In relation to chemicals, SLCA would assess the social implications of chemical production, use, and disposal, including aspects like working conditions, health and safety, and community engagement. This assessment helps identify potential positive and negative social impacts associated with chemical products.
